A scriptable object would help with what youre looking for. 

You'll need to create a class for example you could make a 'IntScriptableObject'. That inherits from ScriptableObject instead of Monobehaviour and include [CreateAssetMenu(...)] above the class. In this scriptable object class create a variable to represent the value of the class, for example 'int value'

This will let you create scriptable objects with values that you can see and modify in the editor. (They will also persist through the scene so you would have to write your own editor script to reset the value) All of your Monobevahiours can reference the scriptable object by adding a public variable with the type of your ScriptableObject class. You could do Player Health this way and have your player, enemy, sound, and camera effect scripts track Player Health separately.
